notes.title: Beta 0.5 - Valkyrie Endings
notes.content:

 New event for Valkyrie ending


Stay tuned for further updates. Once again, I appreciate everybody who has contributed so far.

notes.title: Beta 0.4.7 - Difficulty & QOL
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

Yes, this version numbering is a bit weird.  No, you didn't miss anything between 0.4.4.6 and 0.4.7 - and no, the Great Leader will not elaborate any further on this decision!

Joking aside, here's the updates from the last version:

- Typo fixes throughout the game
- Visual fixes (e.g. timing and displaying of sprites and Budget/Pop/Favor screens)
- Increased difficulty for a spoilerific story element (play the game or check the Discord for details!)

Good luck while you face the wars and the purges to come, Commanders!

Join the Discord and drop your feedback about the game!  https://discord.gg/XxYtYqYVwx

notes.title: Patch 0.4.4.6 - Achievements fix part 2, back-end changes
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders!

Today's patch deploys a second fix for Steam achievements in which you would be constantly awarded the same achievement over and over.

Additionally, there's a number of bug and typo fixes throughout the game, plus a few back-end changes to make the script run more smoothly.

Sorry, no new content changes yet!  The last few months have been extraordinarily busy for me at work.  Once I have time to spend with War of a Madman's Making, I'll be adding some content updates, GUI updates, and other fun stuff!

notes.title: Patch 0.4.4.5 - Achievements fix
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders!

Today's patch - 0.4.4.5 - mainly fixes an issue where Steam achievements were getting cleared any time you started a new game.  (I learned that the Ren'Py `clear all` feature doesn't do what I thought!)

In addition, there's a number of bug fixes and typo fixes throughout the game.

Thanks to everyone who's played so far and left positive feedback!  I'm slowly figuring out just what I want to do with the GUI to make the presentation a little less bare-bones.  I appreciate your patience!

notes.title: Patch 0.4.4.4 - Typo fixes
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders!

Today's update - Beta 0.4.4.4 - is a simple update that fixes typos, cleans up some sentences, and begins adding color to nation names and character names where missing.

In the next few updates, I'm hoping to add some new GUI elements such as a graphical Favor bar and the game over screen.  Stay tuned!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.4.3 - Typo fixes; Return from Hiatus!
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders!

Today's update is a small one.  All it does is fix some typos in the game script.  (Many thanks to everyone who continually supports development and submits bug and typo reports!)

That said, the more significant news is that I'm back from a brief week-long hiatus where I polished and added new graphics to an old VN I wrote called "The King of Cats" - this will be available for FREE on Steam very soon!  (Link to the store page below)

Now that King of Cats is just about finished, I'll be focusing my primary attention back on polishing War of a Madman's Making and expanding on the underdeveloped areas such as lore and the Valkyrie path.

In the meantime, I have a few other VN projects I'm working on that I hope you'll enjoy!  Stay tuned for more details.

The King of Cats store page - it will be FREE on launch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2265680/The_King_of_Cats/

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.4.2
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders!

Tonight's hotfix - Beta 0.4.4.2 - fixes some narrative bugs with regards to showing alternate text based on your war plan.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4.4.1
notes.content: This patch - Beta 0.4.4.1 - is a quick hotfix which adjusts the alignment of the quotes displayed in the splash screen and endings.

notes.title: Patch 0.4.4: Typo fixes and Achievements
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders!

Today's patch - Beta 0.4.4 - cleans up typos throughout the game and fixes the following achievements:


 Que Sera, Sera (Yes, it's REALLY fixed this time!)
 Long Live the King


It's a simple one today.  Stay tuned for content updates, GUI updates, and an Achievement guide!

notes.title: Patch 0.4.3: Achievement and Typo Fixes
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders!

Tonight's update - Beta 0.4.3 - fixes some typos in the text, and also fixes a bug where the "Que Sera, Sera" achievement wouldn't activate.

And that's it for now!  Expect updates in the immediate future to be incremental like this one, but rest assured that there are big plans for expanding the game and world of a War of a Madman's Making!

Stay tuned for some official War of a Madman's Making guides in the pipeline.  The first one I'm working on is a guide to 100% Achievement completion.

notes.title: Patch 0.4.2: Updated southern front
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders!

Today's update - Beta 0.4.2 - mainly focuses on Phase 1.  Additionally, there are bug and typo fixes throughout.

Minor spoilers ahead!

...

...

In previous builds, the southern front would always fail to achieve its objective of capturing the capital city.  Now you can achieve your objective of technically capturing the enemy capital.  However, holding the capital will be an entirely different matter...

notes.title: Patch 0.4.1
notes.content:
Greetings, commanders!

Last night, I released the Beta 0.4 build of War of a Madman's Making onto Steam Early Access!

As expected, I ran into some pretty glaring issues almost immediately after publishing.  Today's patch - Beta 0.4.1 - fixes the following issues.

This patch is fully compatible with previous saves.


One ending did not activate properly.
Another ending (Chorsa's ending) did not award the proper Achievement.


... And that pretty much covers it!  I'll be steadily rolling out the updates as I catch more issues.  If you run into anything strange or see any errors, please don't hesitate to drop a line in the Steam forum or on Discord!

https://discord.gg/XxYtYqYVwx
